source: I am never alone. I have the Way.
target: 我并不孤单，我拥有维网。

source: Activate the rune to increase your global speed by %d%% for %d turns.
target: 激活这个符文提高全局速度 %d%% 持续 %d 回合。

deep_observation: 机制错译：源文括注 (in addition to the usual increase based on Willpower) 指的是每次击杀的常规活力获取，而非被动回复。tome 组件 game/modules/tome/class/Actor.lua（commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63）第 3427-3433 行的击杀分支先 src:incVim((src:getWil()*0.5+1)*self.rank)，随后 vim_on_death 再叠加一笔，正是本技能的加成对象；同文件第 254 行 t.vim_regen = t.vim_regen or 0 注明 Vim does not regen，活力根本没有自然回复。译文「此外自然增长受意志影响」把该项改写成受意志影响的自然增长，既与源码矛盾，也与同句前半「每回合会消耗 0.5 点活力」自相冲突，读者会误以为存在一份被意志加成的持续回复。主源 game/modules/tome/data/talents/corruptions/sanguisuge.lua 第 95-96 行（Absorb Life 的 info，activate 中 vim_regen=-0.5 与 vim_on_death=t.VimOnDeath）。
source:
Absorbs the life force of your foes as you kill them.
		As long as this talent is active, vim will decrease by 0.5 per turn and increase by %0.1f for each kill of a non-undead creature (in addition to the usual increase based on Willpower).
surface_observation: 原文括号说明击杀时还会获得基于意志的通常活力增量；译文“此外自然增长受意志影响”将这部分击杀收益误述为自然增长。
target:
当你杀死敌人时，你会吸收目标生命。
		当此技能激活时，每回合会消耗 0.5 点活力；当你杀死一个非不死族单位时，会获得 %0.1f 点活力（此外自然增长受意志影响）。

source: Spell and mind speed increased by 30%
#Target# is being driven mad by the void.
The way to the treasure is to the east. But beware, death probably awaits there.
target: 通向宝藏的路在东边。但是请当心，死亡常常相伴。

source: Nature requires balance in these matters.
target: 自然在这些事上需要平衡。

source: Maj'Eyal will once more know peace. Most of its inhabitants will never know they even were on the verge of destruction, but then this is what being a true hero means: to do the right thing even though nobody will know about it.
target: 马基·埃亚尔将重归和平。大多数居民永远不会知道自己曾濒临毁灭，但这正是真正英雄的意义：即使无人知晓，也要做正确的事。

source:
Transcend the physical and rule over all with an iron will!
		While this sustain is active, 33%% of your damage is converted into mind damage.
		Additionally, you gain +30%% mind resistance penetration, and +10%% mind damage.
target:
超越肉体，以钢铁般的意志统治一切！
		维持此技能时，你造成伤害的 33%% 会转化为精神伤害。
		此外，你获得 30%% 精神抗性穿透和 10%% 精神伤害加成。

source:
Welcome #LIGHT_GREEN#@name@#WHITE#.
You are of the Shaloren, the Elven race with the closest ties to magic, and you are despised.
While your people are at peace with the other kingdoms, many have not forgotten it was your race that created the terrible Spellblaze, thousands of years ago.

You have decided to venture into the old and wild places looking for ancient treasures and glory.

You have come to the north of the Shaloren capital city of Elvala, in search of the Scintillating Caves. It is infested with vermin and seemingly alive crystals.
To the west lies another dangerous place: a camp of Rhaloren. They are renegade Shaloren who do not wish to restrict their magic usage. Stopping them is good for both your race and your treasure hunt.

After days of travel, you have found the caves and entered it. What will you find there...?
target:
欢迎你 #LIGHT_GREEN#@name@#WHITE#！
你是一个永恒精灵，精灵种族中与魔法联系最紧密的一个亚种，你被人鄙视。
虽然你的人民与其他王国和平相处，但许多人仍未忘记，正是你们的族人在数千年前引发了可怕的魔法大爆炸。

你决定前往那些古老而荒野的地方，寻找古老的宝藏和荣耀。

你来到了永恒精灵首都埃尔瓦拉北部，寻找闪光洞穴，那里被害虫和看似有生命的水晶所侵扰。
西部还有一个危险的地方：罗兰精灵营地。他们是永恒精灵的叛徒，不愿意限制他们对魔法的使用，阻止他们对你的族群和你搜寻宝物都有好处。

经过几天的旅行，你发现并进入了那些洞穴，你会发现什么呢？

source: You focus your aim and fire a shot with great accuracy, inflicting %d%% weapon damage.  Afterwords your attack will remain improved for one turn as the chronomantic effects linger.
target: 你集中注意力射出极精准的一箭，造成 %d%% 武器伤害。接下来的一回合内，因时空延续，攻击加成保留。

deep_observation: 关系倒置：源句 Best results occur with tongues never tainted by profanity 说的是材料条件——拿从未被污言秽语玷污的舌头做材料效果最好；译文「最好的结果便是从未被污言秽语亵渎过的舌头」把材料等同于结果本身，把炼金品质提示变成同义反复。同句 if you happen to know any saintly nagas 的 know（认识）被译作「碰到」（偶遇），any 也被窄化为特指的「那些」。证据：tome 组件 game/modules/tome/data/ingredients.lua（commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，blob ec49e3ef2b670b7a20c5400080d8275f94b3cb10）第 60-67 行 newIngredient{id = NAGA_TONGUE} 的 alchemy_text 字段，第 66 行，该字段用于向玩家提示材料品质。
source: Best results occur with tongues never tainted by profanity, so if you happen to know any saintly nagas...
surface_observation: 原文“Best results occur with tongues never tainted by profanity”表示使用从未被污言秽语玷污的舌头效果最好，译文“最好的结果便是……舌头”却把舌头本身误说成结果。
target: 最好的结果便是从未被污言秽语亵渎过的舌头，所以如果你正好碰到那些圣者娜迦……

target: 盾牌由许多黑色的触须交织而成。当你触摸它时，你可以感受它非常明显的反应，它缠绕住你的手臂并将其包裹在一团黑色而温暖的物质中。

deep_observation: 称号错译：the Inspirer 意为鼓舞者/激励者，译文「智慧王后」换成了「有智慧」这一无关属性。证据：tome 组件 game/modules/tome/data/maps/towns/last-hope.lua（commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，blob 32bf53961864cbeb5b47f822b2dd253971836c2c）第 22 行 quickEntity('Y') 的 name 字面量，其 block_move 调用 learnLore(last-hope-mirvenia-statue)；该 lore 在同 commit 的 game/modules/tome/data/lore/last-hope.lua 第 121-129 行，标题同为 All Hail Queen Mirvenia the Inspirer!，正文称其 Soother of Hearts and Minds 以及 change sorrow to joy, despair to hope, defeat to victory，指向鼓舞人心而非智慧。同文件第 20、21 行的 Tolak the Fair、Toknor the Brave 表明该位置是固定称号且须直译其义；同 commit 官方本地化 game/modules/tome/data/locales/ja_JP.lua 第 19917、16954 行作「導きの女王」，ko_KR.lua 第 16832 行作「격려여왕」，均取引导/鼓舞义，无智慧义。
